lines.text: At two in the morning the wind picked up, and Lena's tent started flapping.
One stake had pulled out of the soft ground, and a corner was folding in on her.
Push each stake in at about forty-five degrees, the top leaning away from the tent,
all the way down so only the hook shows.
Stake the windward side first, then tighten every guyline.
Save this before your next camp night.
